findings.title: ECO-LOOM NC Program Review – Engraving Depth Validation Required
findings.description: Review of generated NC program identified engraving toolpath depth reaching approximately Z=-15.740 mm while contour operation terminates at approximately Z=-14.740 mm. The engraving operation is 1 mm deeper than the contour, which is inconsistent with typical branding depths (0.5-2.0 mm).
required_verification: Confirm design intent for branding depth

assumptions.title: Stock Thickness Not Yet Controlled
assumptions.observation: Contour depth of Z=-14.740 mm produces different results depending on actual stock thickness. If 15.875 mm (5/8 inch), approximately 1.1 mm onion skin remains. If 12.7 mm (1/2 inch), toolpath exceeds stock thickness and penetrates spoilboard.
assumptions.impact: Formal production quotation cannot assume machining cycle time, yield rate, spoilage rate, or tooling wear until stock specification is finalized.

notes: Contour geometry verified appropriate for 5 inch x 3 inch handle dimensions
Feed rates conservative (F333 plunge, F1000 cut) - optimization opportunity for production
G92 temporary offset used - consider G54 for production repeatability
Findings do not affect budgetary estimate validity
Production readiness blocked pending MF-001 and MA-001 resolution
Resolution path defined 2026-06-13 - see investigation checklist IC-ECOLOOM-2026-001
